gaps.explanation: This gap has two parts. (1) Missing line: the Debt Service Fund column (p5) prints Transfers in (out) (182,500), and it is not in detail[], so it is added below. (2) Gross vs net: the statement figure 183,800 is the Total Governmental Funds column's net 'Transfers in (out)'. By fund column that is General (164,450), Street 119,105, Debt Service (182,500), Sales Tax (89,350) and CDBG 133,395, net (183,800). detail[] records the transfers gross per fund. Out: General Fund Administrative (253,800) (p20), Sales Tax (89,350) (p16), plus the added Debt Service (182,500) = 525,650. In: General Fund Park 89,350 (p21), Street 119,105 (p15), CDBG 133,395 (p18) = 341,850. Net: 341,850 - 525,650 = -183,800, which equals the statement. The remaining difference on this row, 525,650 - 183,800 = 341,850, is exactly the gross transfers in. That part is different basis, not an error.
